name: Santa María del Campo (Spain)
description: Square yellow flag with a black bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Santa María del Campo (a wall and a cross on green).
history: Municipal flag of Santa María del Campo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly
